question: Hima Das is an Indian ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sprinter**__.

__
 
• **Hima Das** is an Indian **sprinter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Hima Das** is an** Indian sprinter **from the state of** Assam.**
 
• **Hima Das **became the** first Indian woman** indeed the** first-ever Indian athlete** to **win **a **gold medal **in any format of a global track event at IAAF World U20 Championships</stron
